SELECT v.vin, v.id AS vehicle_id, latest.id AS latest_invoice_id, latest.invoice_seq AS latest_invoice_seq, latest.invoice_type AS latest_invoice_type, latest.invoice_no AS latest_invoice_no, latest.invoice_date AS latest_invoice_date, CASE WHEN latest.invoice_type = 'INVOICED' AND latest.stage_status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_formal_invoice, COALESCE(cnt.invoice_count, 0) AS invoice_count FROM t_vehicle v LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.* FROM t_veh_invoice i INNER JOIN ( SELECT vehicle_id, MAX(invoice_seq) AS max_seq FROM t_veh_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY vehicle_id ) x ON x.vehicle_id = i.vehicle_id AND x.max_seq = i.invoice_seq WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) latest ON latest.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vehicle_id, MAX(invoice_seq) AS max_seq, COUNT(1) AS invoice_count FROM t_veh_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY vehicle_id ) cnt ON cnt.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE v.deleted = 0 AND v.lifecycle_stage IN ('PENDING_INVOICE', 'PENDING_PAYMENT')
AND v.vin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.vin}, '%')
AND latest.invoice_type = #{query.invoiceType}
AND latest.invoice_type = 'INVOICED' AND latest.stage_status = 'CONFIRMED'
AND (latest.invoice_type IS NULL OR latest.invoice_type != 'INVOICED' OR latest.stage_status != 'CONFIRMED')
ORDER BY v.id DESC
